## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The Commands section of `AGENTS.md` still tells contributors to run `make test`, a target this pull request removes. The repository has no CI, so that stale instruction should be fixed before merge.

## Changes
The Makefile's `test` target is renamed to `check` and the README's instruction is updated to match. `AGENTS.md` gets a new Layout section listing each file and the Makefile targets.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- AGENTS.md:24 — comments — Update the Commands section to `make check` — Anyone following "Run `make test` before you push; it runs the pytest suite." now gets a missing-target error, because `Makefile:6` defines only `check`. The same file's new line 15 says the Makefile defines "the `check` and `lint` targets", so the guide contradicts itself. — `AGENTS.md:26` says these commands are "the only checks a change gets", so a failed `make test` leaves pushes with no test run at all.
